bagPolicy.summary: The Bill Graham Civic Auditorium allows factory sealed water bottles, empty refillable water bottles, personal food items, and empty Camelbaks. Totems less than 6ft tall and at 1/2in thick are also permitted if made of light materials.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There is limited parking around the Bill Graham Civic Auditorium, so plan accordingly. The Civic Center Garage nearby charges a flat rate during events. Carpooling and public transportation are encouraged.

rideshare.note: Lyft is the official rideshare partner of the Bill Graham Civic Auditorium.

concessions.note: The Bill Graham Civic Auditorium offers a variety of food and drink options typical of concert venues, including snacks, beverages, and possibly local food vendors. Special offerings or highlights are not specified.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Bill Graham Civic Auditorium, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Bill Graham Civic Auditorium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Box Office opens 30 minutes prior to door time on the night of the show and is located at the front of the venue at 99 Grove Street (closer to Larkin Street). Bill Graham Civic Auditorium do not have regular box office hours at Bill Graham Civic Auditorium but we are open for sales 2 hours before show time on all show nights.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Bill Graham Civic Auditorium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
